descriptions.description: We have curated clinical and imaging data for covid19-positive patients admitted to the SBU hospital. The dataset consists of de-identified Radiology imaging data along with linked clinical data for each patient. The clinical data consists of diagnoses, procedures, lab tests, covid19 specific data values (e.g., intubation status, symptoms at admission) and a set of derived data elements, which were used in analyses of this data. The clinical data is stored as a set of csv files which comply with OMOP Common Data Model data elements.

titles.title: Stony Brook University COVID-19 Positive Cases
